http_ratelimit.description: daeese.me - rate limit por IP antes dos Workers e dos tunnels (plano Free: 1 regra)

rules.description: Rotas que custam Worker, tunnel ou chamada a Discord/Roblox: 60 req/10 s por IP
rules.expression: (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/oauth/") and http.request.uri.path ne "/oauth/roblox/result") or http.request.uri.path eq "/login" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/w/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/p/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/g/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/c/")) and not cf.bot_management.verified_bot

http_request_firewall_custom.description: daeese.me - regras custom (plano Free: 5; uma fica livre para emergencia)

rules.description: api.daeese.me so atende o daese-api-proxy; acesso direto ao tunnel pula todos os limites do Worker
POST so onde existe rota que o recebe; o site estatico nunca recebe POST. /cdn-cgi/ e da propria Cloudflare (beacon, resolucao de desafio)
rules.expression: http.request.method eq "POST" and not (http.host eq "daeese.me" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/")) and http.host ne "api.daeese.me" and not (http.host eq "clips.daeese.me" and http.request.uri.path in {"/login" "/logout" "/api/rescan"}) and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cdn-cgi/")

rules.description: Caminho + query acima de 4 KB nao e uso real de nenhuma pagina

http_request_cache_settings.description: daeese.me - cache de borda do site estatico

rules.description: HTML do GitHub Pages elegivel para cache, respeitando o max-age=600 da origem
rules.expression: http.host eq "daeese.me" and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/oauth/")
